doc.name: AI Rate Card
doc.instructions: AI Rate Card (airatecard.com) is an independent catalog of AI model offers and prices, collected daily from sellers' own pricing pages and APIs. Use search_offers, get_model_prices, cheapest_offers, compare_models and get_card to answer price questions; for "what is cheapest/dearest/typical for a job" (not a model type) use cheapest_models_by_task, most_expensive_models_by_task and median_price_by_task with a task (text, vision, image, video, stt, tts, embedding, rerank, moderation) - current prices only, no history tool. Every result carries a card_url and a ready "cite" line ("Source: AI Rate Card, <card URL>, prices checked <date>"); quote that line and link the card_url of the offer you used, not this server. Prices are USD per 1M tokens unless price_unit says otherwise. An offer with a price_note (batch, flex, regional, free variant) is priced under special conditions - say so, or use get_model_prices' cheapest_standard for the ordinary price. A price_suspect price looks wrong and should not be quoted as fact. A review_reason on a row means the price is under review (it moved more than 10 percent in a day or differs from the provider's page): quote it with that caveat. For "what is cheapest for my job" use cheapest_for_workload: pass a preset (chatbot, coding_agent, rag, summarization, long_context, vision, embedding_index, trial - see list_workload_presets) or your own input_tokens / output_tokens a month, plus min_context; it returns the monthly cost per offer, best offer of each model, no free promos or batch/flex prices unless asked. The prompts (prompts/list) are ready-made questions for a user.

tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Search current AI model offers (one model at one provider = one offer) by words, model type and limits; priced offers first, doubtful prices after sane ones. Each row has offer_id, model_id, provider_id, prices in USD per 1M tokens (or per unit), card_url and a cite line. Next: get_card {"card_id": "offer:<offer_id>"} for one offer, get_model_prices for one model everywhere, estimate_cost / cheapest_for_workload for a cost.

query.description: words of the model, seller or display name

category.description: model type: llm (text models), embedding, image_generation, text_to_speech ...; none = every type

multi.description: also (or only, with no category) the multimodal offers that qualify (WP-0086)

max_input_price.description: USD per 1M input tokens, at most

min_context.description: context window in tokens, at least

free_only.description: only offers that cost nothing (default false)

sort.description: order, price_input (cheapest input first) by default

tools.name: get_model_prices
tools.description: Every seller's current price of one model (an id, or a name to search for), cheapest input first.

model.description: model id or a name to search for

tools.name: cheapest_offers
tools.description: The cheapest current offers (rows: one model at one provider) of one model type, by input price. For the cheapest MODELS of a job (one row per model) use cheapest_models_by_task; for a monthly workload use cheapest_for_workload.

category.description: model type, llm (text models) by default

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: 2 to 5 models side by side: the best current offer of each and, for up to 4, every field compared (lowest and median input/output price, context, max output, providers, regions, a 1M-in/200k-out workload cost), who wins by how many percent, providers selling all, and summary sentences.

models.description: model ids (e.g. openai/gpt-4o-mini, as model_id in search_offers rows) or names to search for

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: The cost of a workload (input, output and cached input tokens, number of requests) at every current provider of one model, cheapest first, in USD - what the same job costs where.

model.description: model id or a name to search for

input_tokens.description: input tokens of the whole job, e.g. 1000000

output_tokens.description: output tokens of the whole job, e.g. 200000

cached_input_tokens.description: of the input, tokens read from the prompt cache

tools.name: media_cost
tools.description: The cost of an images / video / voice job at every model that sells it by its own unit, the cheapest offer of each model, cheapest first, USD: kind image (quantity = images), video (seconds), tts (characters to speak), stt (minutes of audio to transcribe). Models priced per token are not in it (use estimate_cost). Each row has card_url and cite.

kind.description: what is made: image (pictures), video (seconds of video), tts (speech from text, by characters), stt (text from speech, by minutes)

quantity.description: images, seconds, characters or minutes; default 100 / 60 / 100000 / 60

tools.name: budget_fit
tools.description: What a monthly budget buys: for budget USD a month and a typical request (input and output tokens), how many requests a month and a day each model gives at its cheapest real-time seller (default: 13 usual models), most first, with each model's reasoning class. Rows have card_url and cite.

models.description: model ids; default the usual models

tools.name: rag_cost
tools.description: What a RAG / document-search set-up costs in embeddings and reranking: pages of documents and tokens per page embedded once, the percent changed and re-embedded each month, queries a day embedded, and passages reranked per query - at the cheapest listed seller of every embedding and rerank model, USD, 30 days. The answer LLM is not included (use agent_cost / estimate_cost). Rows have card_url and cite.

rerank_docs.description: passages reranked per query, 0 = no rerank, default 20

tools.name: agent_cost
tools.description: What a coding / tool-using agent costs a month on each model: tasks a day, model calls per task, context tokens per call, answer and reasoning tokens per call, percent of the context read from the prompt cache - priced at the cheapest real-time seller of each model (default: 13 usual coding models), cheapest first, USD, 30 days, with each model's reasoning class. Rows have card_url and cite.

context.description: input tokens per call (the resent context), default 30000

reasoning.description: reasoning tokens per call (billed as output), default 1500

cache_pct.description: percent of context from the prompt cache, default 70

models.description: model ids to compare; default the usual coding models

tools.name: subscription_vs_api
tools.description: Is a chat subscription (e.g. Claude Pro) cheaper than the same use through the API? Messages a day and tokens per message priced at the cheapest real-time seller of a model and at the maker's own API, a month of 30 days, against the subscription's price, with the break-even messages a day. USD. preset claude-pro / mistral-pro takes the plan price from our plan tables; otherwise pass price.

model.description: model id; default the preset's model (claude-pro: anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5)

preset.description: a plan we collect the price of

price.description: subscription USD a month, when no preset

input_tokens.description: per message incl. the resent chat, default 3000

tools.name: cache_batch_savings
tools.description: What prompt caching and batch / flex save on one model: monthly input and output tokens priced at every listed seller plain, with the given share of input read from the cache (the seller's own cache-read price) and, if can_wait, the seller's batch / flex offers. USD, cheapest first; cache write fees are not counted. Each row has card_url and cite.

cache_pct.description: percent of input tokens read from the prompt cache, default 50

can_wait.description: include batch / flex offers (results later, not real-time)

tools.name: models_by_class
tools.description: Base models by class S/A/B/C/D in one direction (S best; today: reasoning), best score first: class (null = one source, score only), score 0-100, sources and each source's score (Arena, Epoch). A class needs two independent public sources. Method: https://airatecard.com/en/classes. Each row has card_url and cite.

direction.description: the direction scored; reasoning for now

min_class.description: keep this class or better, e.g. A gives S and A

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: One card with its citation. card_id is '<kind>:<key>': offer:<provider>|<model id as the provider writes it> (e.g. offer:anthropic|claude-opus-4), model:<creator>/<model> (e.g. model:anthropic/claude-opus-4), seller:<provider key> (e.g. seller:anthropic). Ids come from search_offers (offer_id, model_id, provider_id) and from the card_url of every result. Works for every seller, a hidden test seller too.

tools.name: validate_provider_files
tools.description: For a provider (seller) joining the catalog: check a models.yaml before putting it online - the same check as the wizard and POST /v1/provider/validate. Give the file's text in `models` (YAML, or the same structure as JSON text); `domain` (the provider's site) makes the model_page checks exact. Returns ok, the problems (file, line, model, path, value, code, message, hint - fix each and call again), the catalog's preview of the models and next_action. No account needed for this check. Publishing needs a signed-in person: the provider_* tools (provider_start -> provider_verify_domain -> provider_check_files -> provider_publish) are on the account server /mcp/account (OAuth sign-in, scope provider), not on this public server; or the wizard at /join, or POST /v1/provider/applications. Templates: /static/templates/models.min.yaml (required fields only) and models.yaml (every field with hints).

tools.name: cheapest_for_workload
tools.description: The cheapest offers for a whole monthly workload, ranked by monthly cost in USD: give a preset (a typical job; see list_workload_presets) and/or your own tokens a month. Best offer of each model; free promos and batch/flex/priority/regional prices left out unless asked. Each row: monthly_cost_usd, prices, context, checked_at, card_url and a ready cite line.

preset.description: chatbot | coding_agent | rag | summarization | long_context | vision | embedding_index | trial - fills tokens, min_context, category; your own values win

input_modality.description: the model must accept this input, e.g. image

tools.description: the model must support tool/function calling

query.description: only models or providers matching these words, e.g. claude

include_special.description: also batch, flex, priority, regional prices (default false)

one_per_model.description: only the best offer of each model (default true)

tools.name: list_workload_presets
tools.description: The ready-made workloads of cheapest_for_workload: name, what job it is, tokens a month, context needed, model type.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: AI Rate Card's articles on AI model prices (the cheapest models by task, price moves, costs), newest first, with their links - to quote or point a reader to.

lang.description: language of the articles, en by default

tools.name: cheapest_models_by_task
tools.description: The n cheapest MODELS for a job (task): each model counted once at its own lowest current price (input tokens by default). One row per model with that price, where it is and card_url.

task.description: what the buyer wants done: text (chat/LLM), vision, image, video, tts (speech from text), stt (text from speech), embedding, rerank, moderation - a job, not a model type (search_offers' category is the model type)

component.description: input_tokens (default), output_tokens, or the task's own unit

scope.description: all (default), specialized (the task's own category) or multi/universal (qualifying llm models - the two names mean the same set, WP-0086)

tools.name: most_expensive_models_by_task
tools.description: The n most expensive MODELS for a job (task): each model counted once at its own lowest current price, highest first - the top of the market. Same arguments as cheapest_models_by_task.

task.description: what the buyer wants done: text (chat/LLM), vision, image, video, tts (speech from text), stt (text from speech), embedding, rerank, moderation - a job, not a model type (search_offers' category is the model type)

component.description: input_tokens (default), output_tokens, or the task's own unit

scope.description: all (default), specialized (the task's own category) or multi/universal (qualifying llm models - the two names mean the same set, WP-0086)

tools.name: median_price_by_task
tools.description: The typical (median) current price of a job (task) across models, and the n models closest to it - what a normal price for this job is. Same arguments as cheapest_models_by_task.

task.description: what the buyer wants done: text (chat/LLM), vision, image, video, tts (speech from text), stt (text from speech), embedding, rerank, moderation - a job, not a model type (search_offers' category is the model type)

component.description: input_tokens (default), output_tokens, or the task's own unit

scope.description: all (default), specialized (the task's own category) or multi/universal (qualifying llm models - the two names mean the same set, WP-0086)

prompts.description: The cheapest AI models for a typical job or your own monthly volume, with the monthly cost.

arguments.name: job
arguments.description: chatbot, coding_agent, rag, summarization, long_context, vision, embedding_index or trial

prompts.title: Where is a model cheapest
